data.turoyo: Ḥzele i kefo, d məlle aʕla u ǧənni, maḥatle, amṭele qayso d baluṭo hawxa qawyo, txəsle taḥt i kefayo w maqarsole, maqalbole.
data.translation: Da sah er den Stein, von dem der Geistermann gesprochen hatte, holte einen starken Eichenstamm herbei, schob ihn unter den Stein, stemmte ihn hoch und drehte ihn um.

rationale: Thin Preterit cell: complete physical insertion context with an explicit log antecedent and taḥt-goal.

summary: The lever context has the same physical pushing/insertion meaning as the inherited gloss; the different destination phrase does not establish a new sense or idiom.
txəsle is a completed I Preterit coordinated with levering and overturning; no new stem, box or Detransitive function is needed.
Insertion/pushing permits taḥt plus a stone as destination, alongside inherited b-gawe. The log is recoverable from the preceding clause rather than repeated after the verb.
